analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 RSI 43.1 → 48.2 상승으로 과매도 구간 탈출, MACD 히스토그램 개선세 확인. 그러나 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.72로 위축된 거래량은 상승 동력 부족 시사. 20일 ADX 23.5로 추세 형성 초기 단계로 방향성 확정 이르다. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy decision, RSI rose from 43.1 to 48.2, exiting oversold territory, and MACD histogram showed improvement. However, the volume ratio of 0.72 compared to the 5-day average indicates weak upward momentum. With the 20-day ADX at 23.5, it's in the early stages of trend formation, making direction confirmation premature. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

[모멘텀 지표]

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $100,512) + 밴드폭 51.40% 수준
[지지·저항 구조]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($108,765) vs SMA5 ($107,494)/SMA20 ($100,512)/SMA50 ($144,878) — short-term trend above, mid-term trend below
· Position relative to SMA100 ($138,616)/SMA200 ($100,171) — below mid-to-long-term trend

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1 → 48.2) + exiting oversold, recovering towards neutral
· MACD histogram trajectory (2379.9114 → 4226.1550) + improving, weak convergence signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $100,512) + band width at 51.40%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($96,740) + basis (previous low, near Pivot S1)
· Swing resistance ($115,010) + breakout signifies 20-day resistance breach
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation) + bullish reversal signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.72x) + confidence in movement weakened
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + confirmation of wait-and-see conditions
